feeds.title: Hockey One News
feeds.description: The Sultana Bran Hockey One League is Australia's new national hockey league, giving you the chance to see the best of the best competition in fast and exciting games played across Australia. Their news sections deliver all the latest happenings around the Hockey One League, including match results, team lists, important moments of the games and more.

feeds.title: Ice Hockey News Australia Blog
feeds.description: Created in 2014, Ice Hockey News Australia is a blog covering Australian ice hockey news. The blog covers all the major and minor ice hockey events happening in Australia. The news that features here is about the Australian Ice Hockey League, Australian Junior Ice Hockey League, Australian Women's Ice Hockey League, national teams and national championships.

feeds.title: Sutherland Hockey Club News
feeds.description: Sutherland Hockey Club was founded in 1965 and has grown to be one of Sydney's largest and most successful clubs. The club values success on the field but also places great emphasis on enjoyment and fair play for every player. The club's news section shares important hockey-related information and news regarding the club matches.

feeds.title: Underwater Hockey Australia
feeds.description: Underwater Hockey Australia is the official website of the Australian Underwater Hockey Commission. The UHA does all the promoting, developing, and regulating the sport both nationally and internationally. Their blog site covers news regarding the latest updates in Underwater hockey, such as 2023 Australian nationals, Australian team coaches & managers, and team coaching appointments.

feeds.title: Labrador Hockey Club Blog
feeds.description: Labrador Hockey is a family club with their own clubhouse within the Gold Coast Hockey Precinct at Labrador. They cater for players from 4yrs up to masters players and competition runs from March until September each year. You can follow their blog to get all the inside information regarding the matches, tournaments, trials, trainings, award nomination and much more.

feeds.title: Rachael Lynch » Hockey
feeds.description: Rachael Lynch is a Hockeyroo, Olympian, Nurse, and Day & Lifeline Ambassador. On her personal website, she has a news section that covers hockey-related news as well as Rachael Lynch's life activities. The news section of her website covers topics about mental health, hockey associations, the latest squad list, podcast, and more.

feeds.title: Just Hockey Blog
feeds.description: Started in 1986 Just Hockey is your one-stop solution for your hockey-related products and news. They sell hockey products such as sticks, shoes, protection gear, bags, clothing accessories, balls, and many more. The company's blog features news about hockey tournaments, major announcements, teams, matches, results, and other related information.

feeds.title: Skaters Network Blog
feeds.description: Started in October 2009, Skaters Network is a platform for all your skating and hockey needs. Their main goal is to make everyone more aware of how much skating equipment is actually readily available in Australia. They sell hockey gloves, helmets, sticks, gear, jerseys, and more. They also have a blog that features tips and tricks to better your game, interviews of athletes, game reviews, and other hockey-related information.

feeds.title: School Sport Australia Blog » Hockey
feeds.description: Since its establishment in 1981, School Sport Australia has been responsible for the development and promotion of school sports in Australia. They provide high-quality national sports championships for representative State and Territory school sports teams. School Sport Australia hockey blog shares all the significant news of school hockey in Australia from championships and match results to all year calendar.

feeds.title: Hockey Burleigh Blog
feeds.description: Hockey Burleigh Incorporated has been established since 1967. Hockey Burleigh is a member of the Queensland Hockey and Gold Coast Hockey Association. At Hockey Burleigh, they cater for all ages and experience levels, Cubs, Joeys, U11, U14, Open Juniors, and senior grades. The club's blog shares details of all the tournaments and matches the club participated along with some junior, senior, and social news.

feeds.title: Ryde Hunters Hill District Hockey Club
feeds.description: Situated in Sydney, Australia, Ryde is one of Australia's largest Hockey Club and caters for Men's, Women's and Junior hockey players of all ages & levels. The clubs blog features news like Men and women Training Times, hockey season schedules, Club Trivas, championship results, registration news.

feeds.title: Ice Hockey Australia
feeds.description: Ice Hockey Australia has six state-member ice hockey associations and is the recognized governing body for ice hockey in Australia. IHA is affiliated with the Australian Sports Commission (ASC), and Australian Olympic Committee (AOC), and is an active member of the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF). They also have a blog page that gives you updates about the 2023 IIHF ICE HOCKEY championship, teams, players news, game results, important notices, and more.
